name: Bulk Export Import Images SEO Attributes
author: Jitin Mishra

sections.description:
Bulk Export Import Images SEO Attributes is the complete visual SEO studio for WordPress and WooCommerce.

Did you know that editing an image’s ALT text in the standard WordPress Media Library does not update existing page builder content? If an image is already placed inside Elementor, Divi, Bricks, or Gutenberg, it retains stale, empty, or outdated ALT text—damaging your Google Image search rankings and accessibility scores.

This plugin solves this with a Dual-Layer Image SEO Architecture:
1. Global Media Library Layer: Edit default ALT text, Titles, Captions, and Descriptions stored on your attachments.
2. Contextual In-Page Placements Layer: Detect and update the exact active ALT attributes rendered inside Elementor, Gutenberg, Bricks, Divi, Avada, Thrive Architect, Beaver Builder, and WooCommerce, without breaking your visual page layouts!

Key Features

  • Interactive On-Screen Spreadsheet Grid: Edit ALT tags and titles directly in table cells with keyboard navigation (Tab, Enter) and seamless inline auto-saving.
  • Dual-Layer In-Page Contextual Editor: Give each occurrence of an image unique, context-specific ALT text depending on which page it appears on.
  • Universal Page Builder Integration:
    • Elementor: Scans and safely updates internal _elementor_data JSON widgets with automatic CSS/page cache invalidation.
    • Gutenberg / Core Blocks: Updates block JSON attributes and HTML markup.
    • Bricks Builder: Traverses element trees and updates image attributes.
    • Divi Builder: Detects and updates Divi image and gallery modules.
    • Avada (Fusion Builder): Updates Fusion image shortcodes and embedded tags.
    • Thrive Architect & Beaver Builder: Updates visual modules and purges builder asset caches.
    • WooCommerce: Updates featured product images, galleries, and product descriptions.
  • Multimodal AI Vision Auto-Captioning: Direct integration with Google Gemini and OpenAI to visually analyze images and write descriptive, human-quality ALT text with target keyword/niche directives. Features automatic model discovery and cascade fallback. Includes a zero-config built-in smart vision simulator for instant testing with no API keys required!
  • Multi-Sheet Microsoft Excel (.xlsx) & CSV Export: Export a 2-sheet workbook (Global_Media_Library + Contextual_Placements) or standard UTF-8 BOM CSV.
  • Safe Visual Dry-Run Import Preview: Inspect side-by-side color-coded diff tables comparing your original database values against spreadsheet values before committing changes.
  • Local SEO & EXIF/IPTC Geotagger: Inject GPS coordinates (Latitude & Longitude), city, state, business entity name, and copyright notices directly into JPEG binary headers and inject Schema.org ImageObject JSON-LD to dominate Google Maps and Local Pack rankings. Includes 1-click major city presets.
  • Site-Wide Image SEO & Core Web Vitals Auditor: 1-click deep crawler identifying missing ALT text, 404 broken images, oversized image files (>500KB), and missing dimensions causing layout shifts (CLS), with 1-click automatic remediation.
  • Bulk Formula Pattern Generator: Auto-fill empty ALT tags across hundreds of images using dynamic smart tokens ({image_title}, {clean_name}, {keyword}, {site_name}, {year}).
  • Live SEO Gauge & Character Length Indicator: Real-time counter and automated health score (20/100, 75/100, 95/100) providing instant feedback as you edit.
  • Flexible Pagination & Per-Page Controls: Choose between 20, 50, 100, or 200 items per page across both Global Media and Contextual Placements grids.

Universal Page Builder Support

Whether you build sites using block themes or visual builders, this plugin automatically syncs metadata without breaking page designs:
* Gutenberg (Block Editor)
* Elementor & Elementor Pro
* Bricks Builder
* Divi & Extra (Elegant Themes)
* Avada (Fusion Builder)
* Thrive Architect
* Beaver Builder
* WooCommerce Product Galleries

sections.installation:
1. Log into your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New and search for Bulk Export Import Images SEO Attributes.
  3. Click Install Now, then click Activate.
  4. Navigate to the new Image SEO Studio menu item in your WordPress admin.

Alternatively, download bulk-export-import-images-seo-attributes.zip, upload it via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, and activate.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin modify visual builder layouts or break designs?

No. The plugin includes specialized builder adapters that target only the image ALT and title attributes within the builder postmeta, leaving all styles, layouts, margins, and custom CSS untouched. It also automatically invalidates builder caches so changes appear immediately on your frontend.

What happens if the same image is used on multiple pages?

With our In-Page Contextual Placements tab, you can assign different, tailored ALT text to each page placement, while maintaining a global default ALT text in your Media Library as a fallback.

Do I need an OpenAI or Google Gemini API key to use the plugin?

No. The plugin includes a built-in Smart Vision Simulator that generates high-fidelity descriptive tags based on file metadata and context without any external setup. If you enter your own Gemini or OpenAI API key, live cloud vision intelligence is activated with zero markups or middleman fees.

What is the Safe Dry-Run import preview?

When importing an Excel or CSV file, the Dry-Run feature scans the spreadsheet and displays a side-by-side comparison table showing original database values vs. incoming spreadsheet values. You can review all updates before committing them to your database.

Can I export to Microsoft Excel (.xlsx)?

Yes. You can export directly to a multi-sheet Microsoft Excel workbook containing two organized tabs: Global_Media_Library and Contextual_Placements, or standard CSV.

How does the Local SEO Geotagger help my rankings?

It writes EXIF/IPTC binary tags directly into JPEG files and outputs Schema.org ImageObject JSON-LD on your frontend pages, signaling your exact business coordinates to Google for Local Pack and Google Maps image queries.

Do you offer custom plugin development, enterprise migrations, or agency white-label services?

Yes! If you need custom builder adapters, enterprise image optimization pipelines, or bespoke WordPress and WooCommerce plugin development, reach out directly to our engineering team at Simple Intelligent Systems: plugins@simpleintelligentsystems.com.
